verdict.rationale: A federal corporate registry could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web-based filing through the Online Filing Centre and PDF forms, and the probe notes the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The keyless CKAN API on open.canada.ca belongs to the national open-data platform, not the product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
